inputs.prompt: A single video game boss creature on a plain flat blue grey background, drawn as clean game art with crisp dark outlines and simple cel shading, not a photo. A huge, heavy cave bear in three quarter view facing left, walking on all fours. Its near foreleg has grown into a giant steel grappling claw, much longer and thicker than its other legs, made of dark gunmetal steel segments, its three huge hooked steel fingers folded into a fist that it walks on like a gorilla's knuckles, so its shoulders sit high and its back slopes down to low hips. Its ribs have pushed out through the fur of its chest as a cage of curved steel bars, and a round turquoise heart glows behind the bars. A steel crest grows along the top of its skull and stops above its small eyes. Shaggy warm brown fur, a massive shoulder hump, a huge heavy head with a scarred muzzle; its other paws are ordinary bear paws with dark claws. Thin turquoise glowing seams where steel meets fur. Menacing, heavy and sad, real animal proportions. The whole body inside the picture, no ground, no shadow, no text.
